newsitem.title: GERMANY: Agiv sells Wayss stake to HBG.
newsitem.headline: Agiv sells Wayss stake to HBG.

text.p: German holding company AGIV AG said on Monday it had sold its 74 percent stake in building group Wayss&Freytag to Dutch-based Hollandsche Beton Groep NV (HBG) for some 300 million Dutch guilders.
AGIV said that with the proceeds from the stake sale it now expected its 1996 earnings to be at least equal to those in 1995. HBG said it planned to purchase the remaining shares in HBG over time.

AGIV managing director Udo Stark told a news briefing in Frankfurt on Monday that the group expected the 1996 result to be at least equal to that of 1995, when it made a 44 million mark operating loss.
He added that, following the transaction, AGIV's capital-to-assets ratio would rise by some seven percent to 27 percent, while debt would be reduced and cash flow increased by the deal.
